notes.title: The NEW Time Tenshi is Out Now on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The NEW Time Tenshi is out now on Steam! Join Rose, Kyo and the rest of the cast in a reimagined adventure to stop Chrontek and save Kenji's future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/862280/Time_Tenshi/

Enjoy!

- Silver Cow Studio

notes.title: Back the NEW Time Tenshi on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're super excited to announce that the [b]NEW Time Tenshi[/b] is now live on Kickstarter! - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvercow/time-tenshi-time-travelling-anime-visual-novel/

Check out the Kickstarter page to see the official trailer for the latest game in the Time Tenshi series, as well as info on exclusive rewards available only to Kickstarter backers!

Thanks for your awesome support guys,

- Silver Cow Studio

notes.title: Trading Cards added to Burokku Girls!
notes.content:

By popular request, we're hyped to reveal today that [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] have been added to Burokku Girls!

You can collect a total of 10 epic trading cards, and each one includes a bit of story on the character. Plus you can pick up badges, profile backgrounds and more!

Have fun collecting them all!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/443980

- Silver Cow Studio
